out.line: Ingrid is waiting at Haven to head out to forage together — the promise is due day 14. Talk to them before you leave today.

wedgeSits.commitLine: "Wait — I'm away from Haven, out on the road. I can't promise a dawn meet while I'm out — find me when I'm back, and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Ingrid
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Done. The meadow edge, west of the creek, at sunup. Two packs between us."

wedgeSits.name: Ingrid
wedgeSits.actionLine: Ingrid shrugs, hands empty of anything edible. "Nothing we can eat here — wood and green we cannot name yet. We keep walking."

commitLog.line: "Out on the road, away from Haven. A dawn meet's not something I can promise while I'm out — when I'm back, find me, and we'll set it then."

performLog.line: Ingrid falls in beside you. "Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground. Let us go find the green."

dawnOutingLines.line: 📺 The System presses something humming into your hands: Living Soil Robes. The hem is composting. The shoulders are sprouting. You are a walking garden bed.
